pairing_pin.description: BLE pairing passkey (TASK-237). null or absent = no auth; integer 0–999999 = passkey auth.

debounceMs.description: Project-wide button-debounce window in milliseconds (EPIC-028). Applied uniformly to every configured button — buttonPins[] action buttons and buttonSelect alike. Absent = default to 100 ms.

pinNames.description: Optional vocabulary translation layer (EPIC-029 / TASK-378). Maps physical pin identifiers (stringified GPIO number, e.g. "13") to a standard role name from data/pin-names.schema.json. Builders use this to declare what each pin does on their board so profiles can reference roles symbolically ("button_a") instead of hardware pins ("D13"). The mapping is optional: configs without it work unchanged, and configs that map some pins but not others are valid (per-pin opt-in). Values are constrained to the v1 standard name set via $ref; unknown names are schema errors. Keys must be stringified non-negative integers ("0"–"39") matching the GPIO range used elsewhere in this schema.
